commodity.title: Service
commodity.remarks: Service or type of work associated with the ticket. Can serve as a way to categorize tickets. Click the Detail Menu button to select a value or to view related records for this service.

plusginctype.title: Incident Type
plusginctype.remarks: The type of incident that occurred, such as an injury or an explosion. This field is used to group similar incidents. This field is used for reporting and assignment purposes. If you select the Observation Type value, you must specify the type of safety observation. Valid values are in the PLUSGINCIDENTGROUP domain.

plusginccategory.title: Incident Category
plusginccategory.remarks: The category of incident that occurred, such as a major incident or a near-miss incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGINCIDENTTYPE domain.

commoditygroup.title: Service Group
commoditygroup.remarks: Service group or organization responsible for performing the work associated with the ticket. Can serve as a way to categorize tickets. Click the Detail Menu button to select a value or go to the Service Catalog application to create one. You can also view related records for this service group.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the ticket template. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

externalrefid.title: External Ref ID
externalrefid.remarks: 'Identifies the ticket template. Hold Internal ID for source MAXIMO

internalpriority.title: Internal Priority
internalpriority.remarks: Importance of the ticket relative to other tickets as categorized by Service Desk personnel. Predefined values include: 1 (Urgent), 2 (High), 3 (Medium), and 4 (Low). Click the Select Value button to choose an internal priority.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: Functional group or organization that owns this type of ticket. Click the Detail Menu button to select a person group or go to the Person Groups application to create one.

assignedownergroup.title: Assigned Owner Group
assignedownergroup.remarks: Assigned Owner Group of the ticket template record. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.remarks: If ticket requires work to be performed by an outside company, name of vendor responsible for the work. Click the Detail Menu button to select a value or go to the Companies application to create one.

class.title: Class
class.remarks: Type of ticket to which a Maximo user can apply the template. You can choose from three classes: Service Request, Incident, or Problem. Click the Select Value button to choose a class.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: Individual person responsible for the ticket. Click the Detail Menu button to select a person or go to the People application to create one.

plusgsftyobstype.title: Safety Observation Type
plusgsftyobstype.remarks: The type of safety observation that is done, such as witnessing an unsafe act or recording an unsafe work condition.

templateid.title: Template
templateid.remarks: Identifies the ticket template. This value must be unique for all ticket template records.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: Organization associated with the ticket. Click the Select Value button choose an organization.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Status of the ticket template. When you create a template, Maximo automatically sets the status to DRAFT. When you are ready for Maximo users to apply the template, set the status to ACTIVE. Set the status of a template to INACTIVE if you do not want it to be used.
